adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` uses `schema.safeParse(...)` but immediately `throw new Error(...)` when `!refreshTokenResponse.success`, so it only ever returns a parse result with `success: true`. Therefore in `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` the subsequent `if (!accessTokenParsed.success)` branch is unreachable/dead code. This is a real, diff-grounded issue but it’s not a functional defect—just redundant logic/misuse of the helper.
